title: Current Topological and Machine Learning Applications for Bias Detection in Text
findings: The paper's findings are general across the bias types studied (religious, racial, gender, orientation) and do not provide specific results for religious bias alone. The overall finding is that monolingual BERT models, particularly mini-BERT (all-MiniLM-L6-v2), with a low k-value (k=3) in the KNN classifier, performed best in classifying text samples by bias type, suggesting they are effective at detecting religious bias from text in the RedditBias dataset. Multilingual models like raw RoBERTa (xlm-roberta-base) performed significantly worse.
